description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added modpack export — instances can now be exported as Modrinth (.mrpack) or CurseForge packs.
2. A new in-house onboarding component now guides first-time users through the account, launch and menu entries.
3. The launch preparation stage now runs on a background thread, eliminating the stutter when tapping launch; the dialog shows mod parsing and scanning progress in real time.
4. The matching API is now auto-selected when installing Fabric/Quilt; a "What's New" entry was added to launcher settings to review the current version's update notes at any time.
5. Control layout editor enhancements: a "snap to adjacent buttons only" toggle, snapping can now align to the same button on both axes, and new/cloned controls default to the screen center; fixed added controls seemingly disappearing behind menus and duplicated keys after crashes.
6. Fixed Classic account re-login dialog deadlock, Modrinth modpack updates always rolling back, favorites database corruption, cape disappearing after page switches, transparent arms with the initial default skin, log-sharing ANR, and theme transparency affecting text/icon visibility.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增整合包导出功能，支持导出为 Modrinth（.mrpack）与 CurseForge 格式
2.全新自研引导组件，首次使用时引导账户、启动与各菜单入口操作
3.启动准备段迁至后台线程，消除点击启动卡顿，弹窗内实时显示解析与扫描模组进度
4.安装新游戏选择 Fabric/Quilt 时自动勾选对应 API；启动器设置新增"更新内容"入口，可重复查看当前版本更新说明
5.控件编辑器增强：编辑吸附新增仅吸附相邻按键开关，支持与同一按钮横纵两轴同时对齐，新建/克隆控件默认屏幕中心；修复添加控件被菜单遮挡看似消失、崩溃后键位重复等问题
6.修复 Classic 账户密码重登弹窗阻塞、Modrinth 整合包更新必然回滚、收藏库数据损坏、切换页面后披风消失、初始默认皮肤手臂透明、日志分享 ANR、主题色透明度影响文字与图标可见性等问题
